name: Building a Plant-Based Plate
instructions: Use the same plate method as any balanced meal: half vegetables, a quarter whole grains, a quarter plant protein.
Vary your vegetables by color through the week to widen the range of vitamins and antioxidants you get.
Add a healthy fat (olive oil, avocado, tahini) to help absorb fat-soluble vitamins from the vegetables.
Watch today's video for dinner ideas you can rebuild around this same plate method.
